note: identifier 0x79: groups of 3 bytes (cell number, millivolts); rows beyond the cell count are dropped
identifier 0x80; normalized to signed degrees (the pack sends values over 100 for negative)
identifier 0x84; normalized so that charging is positive and discharging negative
identifier 0xC0; 1 or more means the current uses the 10 mA, top-bit-for-charge encoding
